name: Zhuhong Ling -Sheng Tu Shi Ri--
source:
"Saint Slaughter X Days" is a visual novel produced by the Hollowings production group. The story will revolve around the conflict between the Templar and the sorcerer, the "goodness" and the "evil".

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/846670/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《圣屠X日》是Hollowings制作组推出的视觉小说。故事围绕圣殿骑士与魔法师、“善”与“恶”之间的冲突展开。

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/846670/]Steam[/url]）
